text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: To Almond Eye

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
By winning the most turf GⅠ races, your 
name has been etched into history.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
By winning the most turf GⅠ races, your 
name has been etched into history.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
Your strength only stoked my fighting 
spirit further—

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
Your strength swells my fighting spirit 
even further—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All righttt! Back-to-back Mile GⅠ 
victories achieved!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—"After the mile, conquer the mega-mile!" 
Senior Eye! I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
Your track record has kindled a new 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: Your race record has inherited a new will.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew... huff, pheew...! It's not enough...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Sharpen your senses even more. —Until the 
brilliance of the Triple Tiara comes into 
view."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's still burned into my memory. 
Ai-chan's Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Totally! For me, it's gotta be the 
"Shinzan Kinen." She was already 
incredible around that time!

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
The way you run, your fighting spirit— 
those extraordinary talents of yours have 
captivated countless fans.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
Your running form, your fighting spirit— 
those extraordinary talents captivated 
many fans.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
And you— are now the very future of the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"And you— are now the very future of the 
racing world."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Now that the racing world is so hyped 
thanks to Ai... how should I commit to it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—It's gotta be something unprecedented on 
that level! Like expanding globally—taking 
on the world, maybe?♪

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
The future of the racing world lies beyond 
surpassing Almond Eye.
choice_data_list: You will live in our memories forever.
You will live on forever in our memories.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I'm happy to receive a letter, but... 
it's almost a little too straightforward, 
I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Or rather! You make it sound like I'm 
retiring!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep running! Because—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Ai! I finally found you!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Epi-san? Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Destiny whispered to me! —Let's head to 
the track together right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When your strength joins with mine, our 
future will shine tens... no, hundreds of 
millions of times brighter!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We're the ones who will hype up the 
youngsters! Come on, lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I have training right now, so 
if you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? But weren't you planning on taking a 
break for the time being?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That was my plan, but I decided against it 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to race right this very second! I 
mean—
choice_data_list: Because I want to win more.
Because I want to win more.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is, let's save our outing 
for another time!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, alright! Warm-up complete!
choice_data_list:
I should probably decide on our next goal 
soon.

We should probably decide on our next goal 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let's see... What's your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "What do you think I should do next?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's right! The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Whether in Dubai or in France... No, 
everywhere! I will win every race across 
the world!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Looks like some strong 
contenders are showing up—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to any junior. I will always, 
always come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you... kidding with me? Well, 
but you're right—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, what kind of races exist out 
there in space? If it sparks my interest, 
I'll fly right there!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we decide on the menu 
next?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?
choice_data_list: I heard an Umamusume broke your record!

Rumor has it there's an Umamusume who 
broke your record!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Grrrr, this is so frustrating~~!! To 
think there was someone so incredible out 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm itching all over to get 
going~~!
choice_data_list: Do you want to try it right now?
Do you want to try it right now?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I want to!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Change of plans, Trainer! First, I'm 
going to beat that Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That girl... —I wonder where she's going?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――I'm going to pass you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series evolves. As long as 
Umamusume run, and as long as there are 
people to support them—it will go on 
forever.
